name: exact-part-mating-datum-hardening-20260716
goal: Harden the reusable exact-part assembly verifier so every released part, bracket, fastener, and threaded connection is bound to unmodified manufacturer geometry, complete published and interface-critical dimensions, source-edition thread data, and independently computed installed mating-datum alignment.
exit_criteria: generated proxies, nominal envelopes, modified manufacturer solids, incomplete secondary envelopes, and partial dimension audits cannot release
every helical thread is bound to a named standard edition, hash-bound standard source, trusted thread-table audit, and the parent part BREP
the verifier transforms each mating port through the installed rigid transform and independently recomputes datum separation and opposed-axis error
declared fit measurements cannot pass when the actual transformed ports are displaced, skewed, mirrored, or carry untrusted thread evidence
thread engagement, insertion, clamp, bolt, structure attachment, exact-BREP interference, and installed-scene collision gates remain mandatory
New Hope terminal and support assemblies remain fail-closed until exact manufacturer solids and real installed receipts exist
primary, adversarial, focused regression, build, rulebook, loop-guard, and formal invariant checks pass
verification_gates: exact-assembly focused tests including displaced, skewed, mirrored, partial-dimension, and untrusted-thread mutations
New Hope threaded-terminal and purchased-support regression tests
GX10 formal invariant proof or exact GX10_PROVER_UNAVAILABLE evidence
